newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch call money slightly up, other rates stable.
newsitem.headline: Dutch call money slightly up, other rates stable.

text.p: Dutch call money rates rose fractionally while other rates were glued to previous levels on Thursday.
Dealers said the special advances rate, announced regularly by the Dutch central bank, was very likely to remain at 2.90 percent when the central bank sets a new pact at 1400 GMT.
The guilder was somewhat weaker at 112.495 per 100 marks from 112.47 on Wednesday.
Call money rates were bid at 3.06 percent in late afternoon versus 3.00 percent on Wednesday.
Three-month deposits were unchanged at 3.12 percent bid and one-year paper was bid at 3.32 percent.
